articles.title: Rajnath Singh opens DRDO missile tech to private sector
articles.summary: India's Defence Ministry has approved the transfer of technology for all conventional missile systems developed by DRDO to Indian industries. This strategic move aims to significantly boost indigenous manufacturing capabilities and enhance self-reliance in defence production. It will accelerate the development and production of advanced missile systems within the country, strengthening India's defence capabilities and strategic autonomy.

articles.title: A brief history of federal lift ticket regulation
articles.summary: In 1975, the Aspen Skiing Company sought US Forest Service approval to raise its lift ticket prices from $10 to $12. This proposal met strong opposition from Aspen residents, highlighting a conflict between corporate interests, government regulation, and local community concerns over recreational costs. The situation exemplifies the challenges in balancing commercial operations with public affordability on federally managed lands.

articles.title: Russia strikes five vessels in Ukraine’s Black Sea ports, escalating maritime conflict
articles.summary: Recent Russian attacks on Ukraine's Pivdennyi and Odesa grain export hubs have triggered fresh global concerns. These military actions severely jeopardise international food supply chains and Black Sea shipping security. The incident underscores the critical impact of ongoing defence operations on global stability and resource distribution, a vital consideration in international relations.

articles.title: quantlint added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new Python tool, `quantlint`, helps detect "look-ahead bias" in quantitative financial models. This critical flaw arises when future data is accidentally used in model development, leading to unrealistic performance expectations and potential losses. `quantlint` efficiently identifies such biases, ensuring the robustness of algorithmic trading strategies and preventing costly errors for developers and analysts.

articles.title: Grant Morrison Criticizes Lanterns’ Hal Jordan and Its Lack of Costumes and Ring Effects
articles.summary: Legendary comic book writer Grant Morrison has expressed significant reservations regarding DC Studios' forthcoming 'Lanterns' series. Morrison, whose extensive work includes acclaimed DC titles, critiques the adaptation's stripped-down approach to the rich Green Lantern mythology, indicating he is "not exactly sold" on the creative direction for the iconic universe.

articles.title: Lanterns: Why Grant Morrison Doesn’t Recognize Kyle Chandler’s Hal Jordan Performance
